definitions.explanation: Restoring one's reputation through good results or achievements after having been criticized or disgraced. A four-character compound (yojijukugo).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧{汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}だ。
examples.english: This time, I'll redeem myself for sure.

examples.japanese: {汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I gave it my all to clear my name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: The athlete who suffered a crushing defeat in the last tournament brilliantly redeemed themselves.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) often used in sports and competitive contexts. Frequently paired with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to achieve/accomplish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to successfully clear one's name)
- {汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to redeem oneself)
- {汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧ (opportunity to redeem oneself)

WATCH OUT:
Often confused with ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧ (recovering one's honor). Some people mistakenly say ⟦{汚名|おめい}{挽回|ばんかい}→汚名挽回：24676_omeibankai⟧, which would literally mean "recovering one's bad name" — the opposite of the intended meaning. The correct forms are {汚名|おめい}{返上|へんじょう} and ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧.
